hint.label: Hyperbole
hint.text:
A hyperbole is an exaggeration which is used to emphasize something.

For example:
My stomach is a bottomless pit.

atoms.b: Alexa has told him ((a million times)) not to disturb her.
atoms.sound: Alexa has told him ((a million times)) not to disturb her.

atoms.a: What does the hyperbole in the sentence express?
b: ++Alexa has already told him many times not to disturb her.
Alexa has never told him not to disturb her.

atoms.b: I am so hungry I could eat ((++an_elephant an_ant)).
